description: 'So what do you think about what's happening?' asked in a kitchen, by someone with a position already formed, of a person whose cousin is not answering their phone.
energy_note: A geopolitical debate while you are waiting for a text.

description: Defend the country and be treated as an apologist. Criticise it and be treated as confirming whatever the questioner already believed. Saying nothing is read as evasion.
energy_note: Three answers, all of them wrong.

aspect: It removes work as a refuge
description: The one place that was a functioning distraction becomes another site of the war. People take leave they cannot afford or go quiet in a way that damages their standing.
energy_note: Losing the only room the war was not in.

aspect: SECONDARY - it drives withdrawal from the host society
description: The predictable response is retreat into the co-national community, which is then cited as evidence of failure to integrate.
energy_note: Withdrawn for cause, and blamed for withdrawing.
notes: Direct interaction with the integration and stereotype material in assets/text/iran.
